text:
tara: Follow-up from INC-345 postmortem: recurring cache-eviction pattern. Goal: final owners, short timelines, and runbook/playbook updates. No all-hands required.
sasha: I'll take playbook escalation text and sample pager.
maya: I'll own runbook PR with config diff and diagnostic/rollback commands. Target 48h.
liam: I'll do canary rollout + verification. Plan: 5% canary, monitor 5m windows, then 50% after 1h if stable. ETA full rollout in 2 weeks.
ops-bot: Tasks created INC-345-R1 (maya), INC-345-R2 (liam), INC-345-R3 (sasha): https://tracker/INC-345-R1
maya: Adding quick triage snippets to runbook:
```
# eviction rate last 10m
curl -s http://metrics.internal/query?expr=rate(cache_evictions_total[10m])
# list keys with shortest TTL
redis-cli -h cache.primary --raw keys "session:*" | xargs -n1 -I{} sh -c 'echo -n {} && echo -n "\t" && redis-cli -h cache.primary ttl {}' | sort -k2 -n | head -n 20
```
sasha: Playbook: add "repeated evictions" path: if 2 incidents in 7 days -> escalate to oncall-sre + oncall-platform and open recurring-review ticket. Include pager template.
liam: Rollback commands I'll add to checklist:
```
# revert feature flag
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $MGMT" https://flags.internal/api/ttl_experiment -d '{"enabled":false}'
# k8s rollback
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/cache-proxy --to-revision=previous
```
maya: Also including a cleanup script to remove experimental keys if needed.
ops-bot: Reminder set: check-in in 5 days for INC-345-R1.
tara: Recap: INC-345-R1 (maya) runbook PR + config diff (48h), INC-345-R2 (liam) canary + verification (canary Wed), INC-345-R3 (sasha) playbook escalation text (EOD Fri). Reopen thread if blockers. :white_check_mark:
